research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Crosschq is researching and developing methods for automatic employment verification using linked data structures. The approach involves receiving requests for employment verification of a company for a user, reviewing data structures for nodes associated with the user, and determining the number of references needed for verification. This area of research focuses on streamlining employment verification processes within AI-driven hiring intelligence platforms.

overview_description.description:
Crosschq is a technology platform that utilizes human intelligence to help companies hire and retain the best talent. Through proprietary software and science, Crosschq gathers people-driven insights from job seekers and those who know them best and converts those insights into predictive data. Crosschq data can be used to ensure people and businesses are well-matched, creating long-term, successful employees, and winning workplace cultures. 

The company’s cloud-based SaaS solutions were built with a talent-first approach that prioritizes trust and transparency, minimizes bias, and protects privacy. Founded in 2017, Crosschq is backed by GGV Capital, Bessemer Ventures, and other well-known Silicon Valley Investors.

product.name: Crosschq Intelligence Cloud™
product.description: A cloud-based hiring intelligence platform that connects candidate evaluation, hiring workflow, fraud prevention, analytics, and quality-of-hire measurement.

product.name: AI Agent (AI Interviews)
product.description: An AI-led interviewing product for conducting structured candidate screens and evaluations, then producing consistent scores and decision-ready reports.

product.name: 360 Digital References
product.description: A digital reference-checking solution that gathers structured feedback on candidate skills, competencies, performance, work history, and culture fit.

product.name: Quality of Hire Analytics
product.description: Analytics for measuring, benchmarking, and improving quality of hire by connecting recruiting activity with post-hire employee outcomes.

product.name: Candidate Fraud Detection
product.description: A candidate-authenticity service that detects impersonation, deepfakes, suspicious behavior, and other fraud signals throughout the hiring lifecycle.

product.name: Resume Matching
product.description: An AI-based resume screening and matching tool that helps recruiters identify applicants whose experience and qualifications align with job requirements.
